description: GM Bee Network Routes is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for Greater Manchester. Map files showing Greater Manchester's walking and cycling network proposals. The dataset is available in MapInfo.tab, Google.kml, ESRI.shp, and GeoJSON file formats. Please acknowledge the source of this information using the following attribution statement: Contains Transport for Greater Manchester data. Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right 2021. Coverage: Transport for Greater Manchester. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for Greater Manchester. It offers 2 resource(s) in .XLSX, .ZIP. The portal shows 2022-02-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
